searchText: yep! But keep in mind that the original SSTORE would cost at least 22100 20000 for the zero -> nonzero, and 2100 for warming up the storage slot It shouldn't be starting at 0 if you overwrite the same slot every time. All you need to do is store an aggregating hash of all transactions. And anytime new transactions come in, you can overwrite the previous one.
